newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RMB, MeesPierson in African joint venture.
newsitem.headline: RMB, MeesPierson in African joint venture.

text.p: Rand Merchant Bank (RMB) and Dutch trade finance bank MeesPierson NV on Tuesday said they had launched a joint operation to promote trade and commodity finance in sub-Saharan Africa.

"The Africa Trade Finance Joint Venture, prompted by the growing trade potential of the African continent, brings together two powerful players in trade and commodity finance," the companies said in a statement.
The aim of the venture was to raise the value added level of trade and commodity finance in under-serviced but competitive sub-Saharan and southern African regions.

"Both parties see considerable benefit in the venture. MeesPierson contributes its business in South Africa without having to establish an office, while RMB gets to benefit from MeesPierson's global banking network," the statement added.
